As a Cream Operator in Maastricht, you ensure that everything on the production line runs smoothly, from quality to technical operations. It is a varied position with plenty of opportunities to learn quickly and grow within the company. What’s your job about? As a Cream Operator, you work on the production line between the bakery and the packaging department. You make sure that the correct fillings and ingredients are processed perfectly. You accurately set up dosing machines and depositors You monitor the quality and weight of the products You identify and solve minor technical issues You keep the production line clean and hygienic You work according to fixed line settings and procedures You will work in an environment where hygiene and quality are top priorities. You will work in shifts: 05:00 – 14:00 13:30 – 22:00 21:30 – 06:00 Occasionally, you will also work on weekends. What skills do you have? Experience as an operator or in the food industry is a plus Technical insight (you can solve minor technical issues) Willingness to work in 2- or 3-shift systems You speak Dutch or English You have your own transportation You are eager to learn and enjoy hands-on work Don’t have all the qualifications yet, but motivated to learn the profession? We would still like to invite you to apply. What do you get in return? Starting salary of €16,75 per hour After 26 weeks: €18,01 per hour Shift allowances: 18:00 – 03:00 → 138% 03:00 – 06:30 → 139% Structured planning and stability in your work Opportunity to obtain certificates (such as forklift/EPT) Working in a stable organization within the food industry

Cruising through a modern warehouse on an EPT with awesome colleagues? Say no more! Apply today as an EPT driver and join us for a warehouse tour tomorrow! 🚀

- Salary up to € 14,99 per hour! 🤑
- Travel allowance of € 0,25 per kilometer!

To keep the warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch and/or English;
- You are available from Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 17:00;

As an EPT driver and warehouse worker, you will never have a boring day! You get on your EPT to gather orders and prepare high-tech products for shipment. Active work that keeps you fit – who needs a gym membership when you get paid to stay active? You will work in a stable team where quality and safety come first. Easy-peasy earning while having fun! 🥳

Are you an experienced HR professional who thrives in a dynamic, international manufacturing environment? Solmax – a global leader in sustainable solutions for civil and environmental infrastructure – is looking for an HR Manager for its Hengelo site.

Your role

As a fulltime HR Manager, you are responsible for the full HR policy at the location. You will work closely with the local management team (Plant Manager and Controller) as well as the international HR team within EMEA. (Strong English communication skills are essential.) You combine strategic insight with hands-on execution and contribute to a positive, safe, and future-oriented work environment.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing and implementing HR strategies aligned with business objectives
- Recruitment & selection, performance management, learning & development, absence management, and compensation & benefits
- Managing relationships with the Works Council and trade unions
- Leading an HR colleague (responsible for personnel administration & payroll)
- Actively contributing to international HR projects and harmonization initiatives
- Promoting employee engagement and satisfaction
- Ensuring compliance with legislation and internal guidelines
- Preparing HR reports and analyses

In this role, you will have the exciting challenge of shaping the HR department to your vision. You quickly understand how things work and how your expertise can help optimize processes! For this, the following is highly valued:

- Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HRM, Business Administration, or a related field
- At least 10 years of experience in a broad HR role, preferably within a manufacturing environment
- Knowledge of Dutch labor legislation and experience with employee representation
- A proactive, independent, and solution-oriented mindset
